topology.module_layout: Multi-package Python + JS hybrid monorepo. Root pyproject.toml declares 9 Python members (uv workspace); root package.json declares 2 JS members (pnpm workspace). Three packages are nested repos (submodules in .gitmodules): acgs-lite, Acgs-Swarm, clinicalguard. Per-package CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/README.md override root conventions. Root Makefile fan-outs to pnpm turbo (JS) and uv + per-package validation (Python). CI path-filtered per package; cross-cutting gate for constitutional-hash drift.

instruction_files: CLAUDE.md (root: permits direct edits under acceptEdits mode, security-sensitive files listed, nested repo discipline, hard constraints on constitutional hashes and API stability)
AGENTS.md (root: comprehensive team operating manual, delegation rules, skills, verification, failure modes)
MONOREPO.md (authoritative registry: which packages exist, what they're gated by, CI paths, submodule pins, required secrets)
CONCEPTS.md (domain vocabulary: Constitution, Constitutional hash, Sealed, Decision Receipt, etc.)
docs/PLAN-MONOREPO.md (6-phase unification plan, 5 of 6 landed for parent-tracked surfaces)
PLAN.md (frontend-only acgi-ai completion plan; does NOT cover monorepo unification)
docs/PROOF_PATH.md (canonical proof narrative: demo commands, security model, what's implemented, what's not claimed)
docs/CLAIMS.md (safe public wording ledger: what to claim, what NOT to claim)
docs/SECURITY_MODEL.md (threat model, fail-closed behavior, receipt validation, replay integrity)
docs/INTEGRATION_MATRIX.md (which runtimes supported, at what proof depth)
.claude/rules/*.md (per-repo security-sensitive files, verification gates, repo boundaries, claim safety)
conventions.coding_standards: Linter-driven: ruff (E, F, I, B, UP, RUF for Python; line-length=100), Biome (JS formatting), mypy (types, --strict in research-engine). Per-file ignore lists for intentional deviations (e.g., E402 for sys.path manipulation). Workspace-level defaults in pyproject.toml [tool.ruff]; per-package overrides win. No hand-style debates; automation enforces all standards.
conventions.testing: pytest (Python) with asyncio_mode=auto, import-mode=importlib. Per-package test paths defined. Coverage collected but not enforced globally. Path-filtered CI per package prevents test drift. Negative-path tests required for security-sensitive changes (proving side effect did NOT run). Handler wiring proved via dispatcher-level tests, not unit-call mocks. Tests smoke the proof path: kernel fail-closed behavior, receipt validation, audit integrity, replay verification, tamper detection.
conventions.review_process: PR-based. Constitutional-hash drift gate runs on every PR + push to master. Per-package CI gates (lint, typecheck, test) must pass. Security-sensitive changes (receipt.py, executor.py, kernel.py, audit.py, replay.py, signing.py, policy.py, integration.py, .claude/hooks, .github/workflows) require: code + tests verified, handler wiring proved, docs updated (CLAIMS.md, SECURITY_MODEL.md, DECISION_RECEIPT_SPEC.md), failure modes documented. `gh pr merge` verify-gated globally (requires fresh verify-pass marker bound to current HEAD SHA). Humans push/merge; agents prepare. OMC coordination for multi-package changes.
conventions.strategy: Receipt-gated governance. Core invariant: No valid Decision Receipt, no side effect. Vendor-neutral (sits below any agent framework). Policy-before-execution dispatch. Tamper-evident audit chain (JSONL hash-linked). Opt-in cryptographic signing (Ed25519). Replay-capable (stateless: re-derive side-store from audit). Integration shapes for MCP, function-call, runtime hooks, CLI. Alpha status (0.1.0.dev0). Local proof pack (security proofs, not production deployment proof). NOT claiming: production-certified, compliance-certified, regulator-approved, sandbox replacement, complete IAM/PKI, formal-verification system.

terms: Constitution — versioned ruleset enforced on every request; source of truth for allow/deny/escalate decisions
Constitutional Hash — content hash of Constitution data; stamped into files as provenance marker; identifies governing ruleset, not per-file content lock
Sealed — status applied to generated files, lock files, constitutional-hash-marked files; must not be hand-edited; integrity guaranteed by re-generation or hash recomputation

Decision Receipt — verifiable proof that an action was authorized under a specific policy; schema-versioned; binds actor, action, arguments, policy evidence, audit reference; required gate for executor
Governed Runtime Kernel — gove-zone: local policy-before-execution dispatch membrane, sits below any agent framework, vendor-neutral
Policy Binding — actor + action + argument + policy + audit proof linked in Decision Receipt; integrity checked at executor gate
Executor Gate — receipt validation checkpoint; enforces: No valid Decision Receipt, no side effect
Audit Chain — tamper-evident JSONL hash-linked log of governance decisions and side effects; integrity verified before replay
Replay — stateless re-derivation of audit chain and side-store from governance log; proves audit integrity and allows offline verification
Signing Mode — opt-in Ed25519 cryptographic signature on Decision Receipts; proves provenance and non-repudiation
Proof Pack — CLI artifact (gove-zone proofpack) containing local security proofs, fixture corpus, tamper-evident demos; proof of implementation, not production deployment proof
Side Effect — file write, API call, database update, email, payment, deployment, MCP tool, shell command, or any action requiring explicit authority
Fail-Closed — default behavior when receipt is missing, invalid, tampered, or mismatched; action denied; audit logged
Adapter Shape — integration contract for runtime/MCP/function-call bridges; defines how gove-zone kernel integrates with agent frameworks
Replay Verification — proof that an action's audit log and side effects match expected state; enables offline evidence validation
Actor — identity claiming authority for an action (agent, user, service account, MCP client)
Tenant Safety — isolation guarantees; audit and policy binding prevent cross-tenant action leakage
